grades.reason: Discusses transactions, message queues and databases in workflows; says nothing about conditional-store (SC/CAS) failures in an atomic update loop.

grades.quote: executing a CMO instruction may cause a constrained LR/SC loop on any hart to fail periodically or may cause a unconstrained LR/SC sequence on the same hart to fail always
grades.reason: RISC-V passage naming concrete causes of LR/SC failure: a cache-block management or zero instruction from another hart to the reservation set, and CMO instructions that can make constrained loops fail periodically or unconstrained sequences fail always. It covers useful causes for diagnosis but not the full set of reasons SC fails.

grades.quote: If the state still matches the earlier snapshot, then no other concurrent thread has snuck in and sold a ticket.
grades.reason: Java compareAndSet retry loop. It shows that a conditional update fails and retries when another thread changed the state. This is generic, high-level background and does not cover hardware conditional-store failure or diagnosis.
Introduces atomicity mechanisms for transactions (serializability, two-phase locking, undo log). It is unrelated to conditional-store failure in an atomic update loop.
